3. Is this a "nice bottle to open together" gift or a "keep/display" gift?
4. Any allergies, dietary restrictions, or religious/cultural considerations around alcohol?
5. Would a non-whiskey/golf backup direction be useful (e.g., high-end coffee gear, leather goods, tech accessories)?

Once I have those, I can suggest specific options.
